description: Turn Your day on for the user and start writing their first brief now, from their inbox. Call this when they ask to start Your day, their morning brief, their relationship brief or their personal branding brief, or say yes to one. Pass `brief` when they named one: 'relationship' (who needs a reply or a nudge today, note written) or 'branding' (who engaged with their posts, next post drafted). The first brief takes a few minutes; the brief card under your reply waits for it and fills in, so say it is being written and stop.

brief.description: The brief they asked for, if they named one.

name: start_your_day
